↶ bounce back✳
a little game about trying again.made for haven ↗ ✳ 2026
a quick field guide

Small brain.
Big comeback.

  1. 01

    Take a little look.

    Remember the words, in order. You start with 15 seconds. Press Enter when you’re ready.

  2. 02

    Type them back.

    The words disappear. Type each word and press Space or Enter to lock it in. Case doesn’t matter.

  3. 03

    Miss? Bounce back.

    Same words, another chance. Your first retry adds 5 seconds; your second adds 3. After that, no extra time and the clock runs 25% faster.

Clean clears grow your multiplier up to 3×. Clear after 2+ bounces for a comeback bonus. Escape pauses your run.
